description_en: Modifies the log delivery status of a protected object in Web Application Firewall (WAF)
description_zh: 修改防护对象日志外发投递状态
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi modify-resource-log-delivery-status --instance-id waf_v2_public_cn-uqm3500000 --resource test.waf.com-waf --status true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyResourceLogDeliveryStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html，查看当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the log delivery configuration.

This parameter is required when you enable log delivery by setting Status to true
parameters.help_zh:
外发投递配置名称。

开启日志外发投递（Status取值为true）时，您需要填写该参数
parameters.name: delivery_name

parameters.help_en: The protected object for which you want to modify the log delivery status
parameters.name: resource

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether to enable log delivery for the protected object. Valid values:

true: enables log delivery.

false: disables log delivery
parameters.help_zh:
防护对象日志外发投递状态。取值：

true：表示开启。

false：表示关闭
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

DeliveryName.description_en: The name of the log delivery configuration

DeliveryType.description_en:
The type of log delivery destination for the protected object. Valid values:

syslog: logs are delivered to a syslog server.

kafka: logs are delivered to a Kafka cluster
DeliveryType.description_zh:
防护对象外发投递类型。取值为：

syslog：表示外发投递到syslog服务。
kafka：表示外发投递到kafka服务

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether log delivery is enabled for the protected object. Valid values:

true: Log delivery is enabled.

false: Log delivery is disabled
Status.description_zh:
防护对象日志外发投递状态。取值：

true：表示开启。

false：表示关闭
